slack.story:
Harbor & Pine Health
A nurse practitioner requests prior authorization for an MRI, and the payer team sees the case in Slack when it stalls.
1. Harbor & Pine Health is the clinic account, with Avery Cole as the patient.
2. A case is filed for prior authorization of an MRI, waiting on the clinical note.
3. The case stalls past the payer's two-day window.
4. The case moves to closed once the note arrives and the request is approved.
Tag: [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]

manualSteps.title: Install the workspace app on the Enterprise Grid org
manualSteps.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to workspaces created later, and approve it if an admin must. This app only creates workspaces. It is not the Salesforce for Slack app, and it does not post Salesforce updates. Skip this when that org install already exists.

manualSteps.title: Store the org-admin Slack token
manualSteps.detail: Keep the org-admin user token, the one with admin.teams:write, in the coding agent's secret store. The agent uses it only to create a workspace. Do not put it in a Salesforce named credential. Keep it out of git. Skip this when it is already stored.

manualSteps.title: Connect the Salesforce org to seed
manualSteps.detail: Sign the coding agent into the Salesforce org that should receive the records. A demo org is the usual choice. The agent uses whichever org that login opens. This login does not connect Slack.

manualSteps.title: Connect this workspace with Salesforce for Slack
manualSteps.detail: Do this for every new workspace. Add the Salesforce for Slack app to that workspace and connect it to the Salesforce org you seeded. In Salesforce, finish Initial Slack Setup if this org is not already allowed to connect. That native connector is how records show up in Slack. Do not replace it with a flow, a named credential, or a call to chat.postMessage.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the demo org
agentSteps.detail: Use the Salesforce org this session is signed into. Create the records there. Do not deploy a flow.

agentSteps.title: Workspace Harbor & Pine Health
agentSteps.detail: Create a workspace named Harbor & Pine Health with admin.teams.create. Use team_domain healthcare-prior-auth. The app is already installed on the Enterprise Grid org and granted to new workspaces. Pass the new workspace id as team_id on workspace-level calls. Do not post a message. Salesforce for Slack is connected by hand after this workspace exists.

agentSteps.title: Beat 1: Account
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Account. Harbor & Pine Health is the clinic account, with Avery Cole as the patient. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 2: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. A case is filed for prior authorization of an MRI, waiting on the clinical note. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 3: Account + Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Account and Case. The case stalls past the payer's two-day window. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Beat 4: Case
agentSteps.detail: Create or update the Case. The case moves to closed once the note arrives and the request is approved. Tag the Name or Subject, and the Description, with [demo-builder:healthcare-prior-auth]. Use an Industry picklist value the org already has.

agentSteps.title: Hand off the Slack connection
agentSteps.detail: Stop here. Tell the person to connect the Harbor & Pine Health workspace to this Salesforce org with Salesforce for Slack. Do not deploy a flow, a named credential, or a callout. The native connector is what shows these records in Slack.

agentSteps.title: Save the spec
agentSteps.detail: Write this plan to demos/healthcare-prior-auth.json with salesforceIds left empty. Put record ids and the Slack workspace id only in demos/healthcare-prior-auth.links.json.
